title: Drop-Off
description: You, a meteor, or a pizza, falling through the space to crash on Earth... though the path is polluted with obstacles—some breakable, some not.
controls:
PC:
- A or Left Arrow key: Go Left
- D or Right Arrow key: Go Right
- Space: Slam
Mobile:
- Tap Left Side of Screen: Go Left
- Tap Right Side of Screen: Go Right
- Press "SLAM" button: Slam

title: The Button
description: Obey The Button. Whatever is first is truth. Crack it or be cracked. Would you mind pressing it? (Hint: You do)
controls: Tap/Click on button as The Button commands you to.

title: Maze
description: You are dropped into a Maze that hunts you. Escape the 3 stages or you'll be its partner...
controls: WASD / Arrow Keys: Move | Mouse: Look around (Click to lock cursor, Esc to unlock) | Space: Jump. On Touch: Virtual joystick & jump button.
